# 3D Industrial Parts

3D Industrial Parts is an industrial 3D printing and engineering-parts service in Thailand. The business produces functional components for real-world use, rather than decorative models or toys.

## Core services

- Functional parts for machinery, production lines, R&D and product development
- Jig and fixture design and production
- Replacement parts based on STEP, STL, 3MF, drawings, samples or dimensioned photographs
- Prototypes for fit, assembly and design validation
- Low-volume production, generally from 5 to 200 parts after engineering review

## Materials

Material selection is based on load, temperature, chemicals, UV exposure, dimensional requirements and operating environment. Candidate materials include PETG, ASA, PC, PA/Nylon, TPU and fiber-reinforced composites. Final availability and suitability are confirmed after design review.

## Quotation requirements

For an accurate quotation, provide the 3D file or dimensioned images, quantity, part function, load, temperature, chemical exposure, critical dimensions and required delivery date.
